h1: Baan Sai Thong — right on Tawaen Beach, steps to the sand, at an easy price on Koh Larn
intro: A small guest house that sells one thing: location — Baan Sai Thong (Baan Saithong) sits right on Tawaen Beach, Koh Larn's most popular stretch of sand, a few steps from your room to the water · It's a 2-star place of around 6 rooms, opened 2013 · A/C rooms with balconies, flat-screen TV, free Wi-Fi, a bar and breakfast · People pick it because you sleep beachfront for a low price · Scored 7.0 from 38 reviews, from approx. ฿900/night.

body.html: The reason Baan Sai Thong stays busy is its spot right on Tawaen Beach · Tawaen is the liveliest beach on Koh Larn — clear water, white sand, restaurants, sun loungers and every water sport going — and this guest house is genuinely on it, a few steps from your room to the sand · For anyone coming to Koh Larn to wake up facing the sea and swim early, before the mid-morning ferry crowds arrive, that's something the inland Na Ban village stays simply can't offer.

The property is a small building of around 6 rooms, open since 2013 · There are only a couple of room types — a Standard Garden View and a Standard Double with a king bed · Every room is air-conditioned, with a balcony, flat-screen TV and free Wi-Fi · Downstairs there's a small bar and restaurant with breakfast service · Rooms are compact, built for sleeping after a full day in the water rather than lingering indoors — which matches how most people do Koh Larn anyway.

"The plus is the location — a few steps and you're on Tawaen Beach, swimming first thing in the morning · Staff were kind and let us check in early · For the price, sleeping right on the beach is fair."

Real guest reviews split cleanly into two camps · The fans score it on the beachfront location and value above all — its location rating runs up around 8.5, well ahead of everything else · Many praise friendly, flexible staff and an okay breakfast for the price · For travellers who come mainly to swim and don't expect more than a cheap beachfront room, plenty say they got what they paid for.

But to be fair you have to say the rest — rooms and upkeep are what reviews complain about most · Cleanliness and service scores sit only in the low 6s · Reviews mention broken fixtures such as a sink or tap that needed fixing, leaks, uncomfortable beds, and some guests ran into cleanliness issues like ants, insects or damp/mould in the bathroom · A few also note noise when the owner is busy downstairs · This is not a place with spotless rooms — it's a place where you trade room condition for being on the beach cheaply.

Honestly, Baan Sai Thong suits people who put a beachfront spot and the price ahead of room condition · If the picture in your head is stepping off the ferry, heading straight to Tawaen, dropping your bag and getting in the water, then sleeping in an A/C room on the beach for a little over a thousand baht — it delivers, and a location like this is hard to find on that budget · But if you want a fresh, clean room, a soft bed or consistent service, a newer place like Tiamo or a better-kept beachfront resort will buy you more peace of mind.

On price, standard rooms start around ฿900/night on weekdays, climbing to roughly ฿1,300–1,600 on weekends and long holidays depending on the date and package · With only about 6 rooms and a beachfront location, it fills fast on holidays · Book ahead, pick a free-cancellation rate, and if you can, ask to see the room before taking the key so you get the best-condition one available that day.

honestSummary: Baan Sai Thong is best for travellers who put a beachfront spot and price ahead of room condition — you sleep right on Tawaen Beach, steps to the sand, for a little over a thousand baht, which is rare on the island · But you have to accept older rooms, inconsistent housekeeping and some broken fixtures — this is a stay that trades room condition for a cheap beachfront location.
honestChecks: If you're sensitive about cleanliness or want a spotless room — reviews complain a fair bit about older rooms, damp and insects → a newer place like Tiamo or a better-kept beachfront resort will feel safer.

If you want a pool or full facilities — this is a small guest house with no pool; its selling point is the sea right outside → for a pool and full service, look at resorts or pool villas on Tawaen or Samae Beach instead.

If you're going on a long holiday weekend — only about 6 rooms and right on the beach, so it sells out fast → book ahead, lock a free-cancellation rate, and ask to see the room before taking the key if you can.

faqTitle: FAQ — Baan Sai Thong, Koh Larn

faq.q: Where on Koh Larn is Baan Sai Thong?
faq.a: It's at 199 Moo 7, right on Tawaen Beach, Koh Larn, Bang Lamung, Chon Buri · It's genuinely beachfront — a few steps from your room to the sand · About 3 minutes by car from Na Ban Pier (around a 17-minute walk) · Easy walking distance to restaurants and water sports on Tawaen Beach.

faq.q: How much does Baan Sai Thong cost, and what rooms are there?
faq.a: From about ฿900/night on weekdays for a Standard Garden View Room · There's also a Standard Double with a king bed · Weekends and long holidays climb to roughly ฿1,300–1,600, and it fills fast with only around 6 rooms — compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Is Baan Sai Thong really on the beach?
faq.a: Yes, it's right on Tawaen Beach — a few steps from your room to the sand · That's the main selling point, and its location score in reviews runs up around 8.5 · Ideal if you want to wake up facing the sea and swim early.

faq.q: What are the rooms like at Baan Sai Thong — are they clean?
faq.a: Rooms are compact A/C rooms with a balcony and flat-screen TV · To be honest, rooms and cleanliness are what reviews complain about most — older rooms, broken fixtures, damp and insects in some rooms · If you can, ask to see the room before taking the key, and if you're sensitive about cleanliness, consider a better-kept stay.

faq.q: How do I get to Baan Sai Thong?
faq.a: Take the ferry from Bali Hai Pier in Pattaya to Na Ban Pier on Koh Larn (about 45 minutes) · From the pier, take a songthaew or motorbike taxi to Tawaen Beach (about 3 minutes) · On the island, renting a motorbike (around 300 baht/day) makes exploring other beaches easy.

faq.q: Who is Baan Sai Thong best for?
faq.a: Best for travellers who put a beachfront spot and price ahead of room condition — here to swim all day, then sleep in an A/C room on the beach for an easy price · Less ideal if you're sensitive about cleanliness, want a fresh clean room and soft bed, or need a pool and full service.
